entries.06714a97c790f5a4: This is a single-segment business conducted by a group consisting of the company, three consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate. As a cloud-based BPO service company for automotive-related businesses aiming to provide an “IT platform” that fuses financial technology and information technology, it provides automotive-related businesses with a system for evaluating and calculating the value of used vehicles, built on information centered on used car market prices. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,733 million.
entries.145fb716e21de6c4: This is based on the descriptions of management policies and strategies in 'Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed, etc.', and of the business and financial issues to be addressed on a priority basis.
entries.1dfd606476e032bc: ASP service for automobile finance operators 'Sisu-Roketto'
entries.1e60dfa1c1c8564f: Since commencing operations in 1992, the company has refined its mechanism for calculating residual values based on used-car sales data accumulated through bidding events and auctions. 'RV Doctor', which went on sale in 2000, has been repeatedly improved and is provided in combination with 'PV Doctor' for calculating present value and the vehicle model catalog database, and the company continues to improve the proposal document function of its flagship 'CA Doctor'. The fact that the majority of revenue is stock-type revenue with the nature of recurring billing also supports the stability of the business.
entries.28d20fb363a6186e: The company states that it calculates the 'value' (future value and present value) of cars and provides systems that connect companies and financial institutions related to automobiles with users and potential users, bringing change to the processes of buying, selling, owning and sharing cars.
entries.2d60f5480671f2e2: It provides services and systems including: the ASP service “Shisurokketto,” which packages functions useful to auto finance operators, led by auto leasing companies; the sales support system for new-car dealers “CA Doctor,” developed by combining the company’s solutions; the batch calculation service “CAV Monitor,” which makes risk visible by comparing residual values set in the past with current vehicle values; and a system that provides finance quote preparation over a network that takes into account the future value (residual value) of vehicles. Consolidated subsidiary Inspiration Co., Ltd. operates a solution business for automobile dealerships.

entries.39489aafdf3bb19a: The company provides, via the cloud, a system that analyzes used-car sales performance data to calculate residual and present values of automobiles, along with a vehicle model information database, and earns consideration for these.
entries.4d810c3311e7ffa1: This is a single-segment business conducted by a group consisting of the company, three consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate.
entries.51ce88acb537d7de: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,733 million, up 4.0% from the previous fiscal year. Revenue with the nature of recurring billing accounts for the majority of sales.
entries.532244ff90fad0e1: The company provides “RV Doctor,” an automotive asset valuation system independently developed by the group, which performs statistical analysis of past used car sales results to calculate the present value (market valuation) and future value (projected sale price) of automotive assets, and “PV Doctor,” a system that uses know-how for calculating future value to calculate the current standard vehicle value without arbitrary judgment.
entries.5782b70dc0a2bc3a: The company refines its core value-calculation function as an analysis engine and incorporates it into multiple products and platforms to expand their use, so improvements in calculation accuracy spread to the value of the entire product lineup.
entries.67e27656ac1bd745: Since commencing operations in 1992, the company has refined its mechanism for calculating residual values based on used-car sales data accumulated through bidding events and auctions.
entries.6b7389ccd2f433bd: The company states that it calculates the 'value' (future value and present value) of cars and provides systems that connect companies and financial institutions related to automobiles with users and potential users, bringing change to the processes of buying, selling, owning and sharing cars. It also states that it aims to become a platform company that builds its business so that all people and companies can naturally be aware of the value of cars in their daily lives. As its short- to medium-term management strategy, the company states that it will further refine its car value analysis engine (deepening data analysis), expand the use of platforms that incorporate the unitized engine, 'RV Doctor', 'PV Doctor' and 'Vehicle Model DB', and expand the provision of platforms that improve the operational efficiency of companies related to automobiles.

entries.75370e05d7fc7b96: The company provides, as cloud-based services, systems that statistically analyze used-car sales results to calculate the future value (residual value) and present value of automobiles, as well as a vehicle model catalog database and business support systems for sales support and similar purposes.
entries.75aebc5d73256eb6: It provides the “Vehicle Catalog Database,” a hierarchical database of text-based car catalogs that includes information such as manufacturer and dealer option prices and taxes.
entries.7836247484184326: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥297 million, down 10.2% from the previous fiscal year.
entries.7e97c7a357070cf2: The company refines its core value-calculation function as an analysis engine and incorporates it into multiple products and platforms to expand their use, so improvements in calculation accuracy spread to the value of the entire product lineup. Progress in introducing new services to the automotive finance market, an existing domain, and in strengthening sales in the automotive distribution market, a growth domain, will determine the expansion of platform use and revenue.

entries.f8f34f6d2e81ef27: The related automotive industry is in an environment with a strong sense of stagnation, with new passenger car sales down 2.2% year on year, falling below the previous year's results for the first time in four years, while registrations of used passenger cars rose 0.4% year on year. Amid continuing structural changes, such as the spread of CASE-related technologies and fluctuations in demand in the used-car market, the company, a small organization with 59 consolidated employees, concentrates its management resources on the specialized field of automotive value calculation.
entries.f9a6a16d4dd1f356: In 1992, the company began operations in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, as a business support company for automobile finance operators. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and the Nagoya Stock Exchange Main Market, and its head office is in Meguro-ku, Tokyo. It forms a group with 3 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate.
